answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The violet holds work receipts rather than names, so the island of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the nectar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
